journey.

# Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification | ACSMI Online Training

The [Advanced Cybersecurity Management Institute (ACSMI)][90] provides professional cybersecurity
certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

Earn your Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification (ACSMC) through our CPD-accredited and
ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or

digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

## What is MessageFlow?

MessageFlow is a ***one-stop-shop for messaging solutions***, an integrated suite of products for
marketing ***cross-channel communication*.** We understand that communication is the backbone of any
successful business relationship.

Communication is a fundamental element of our area of expertise. We help run effective cross-channel
communication: sending bulk ***Text Messages***, highly deliverable ***Emails***, engaging ***Mobile
Push notifications***.

### Deliverability

Experience our outstanding 99% deliverability rate across a wide range of channels and diverse
markets worldwide.

### Scalability

We ensure extensive scalability of your communication process, fostering your success and peace of
mind.

### Expertise

Explore the power of glocal approach, blending 20 years of global experience and technology with
local implementation expertise.

### 24/7 Support

Enjoy the comfort of comprehensive support with premium SLA and care of a dedicated Customer Success
Specialist, consultations, and audits.

## Developer Platform
* Get your messages across all channels with one powerful and easy-to-use API
* Combine the best international practices with in-depth understanding of local markets
* Our support has your back at every stage – ready to advise, verify settings, and run tests
* Enjoy the full security of ISO and GDPR compliance, SOC2, 2FA, anti-phishing shield
* And much more!

## Marketing Platform
* Enjoy the benefits of a single solution using cross-channel capabilities
* Send your marketing campaigns (Emails, SMS, and Push) using an intuitive self-service panel
* Get creative with our user-friendly low-code creator and build your message like a pro
* We are here to provide assistance, verify your settings, and conduct tests
* And much more!

## to Run a Carrier

From SMS delivery to 5G standalone core — a fully integrated platform covering every layer of modern
telecom operations.

Core Messaging
Full-stack messaging infrastructure supporting every protocol and format your business needs.
* SMS/SMPP 3.4 — server & client
* Bulk SMS campaigns with templates
* RCS rich media messaging
* A2P 10DLC compliance
* MMS send & receive
Voice & VoIP
Carrier-grade voice infrastructure with real-time billing and compliance built in.
* AAA billing — real-time balance
* SIP routing with LCR & failover
* STIR/SHAKEN caller authentication
* Ringless voicemail delivery
* Text-to-speech (multi-voice)
Mobile Core
Complete mobile network core from 2G through 5G SA — deploy your own MVNO or carrier.
* HLR/AuC for 2G/3G networks
* 4G LTE EPC (full stack)
* 5G Standalone Core (3GPP R16)
* SIM provisioning & management
* MVNO-ready infrastructure
Number Intelligence
Real-time number resolution and portability lookups for accurate routing and billing.
* ENUM/NAPTR — E.164 resolution
* LNP — Local Number Portability
* MNP — Mobile Number Portability
Protocol Support
Interconnect with any carrier or network using industry-standard signaling protocols.
* SS7/SIGTRAN gateway (MAP/ISUP)
* Diameter OCS (Gy/Ro/Gx)
* SCTP multi-homed transport
* Multi-protocol hub with circuit breaker
Platform & Operations
Operational tools and APIs to manage, monitor, and scale your telecom services.
* Compressed CDR export — 50M+ records/min
* Real-time billing & anti-fraud
* Multi-tenant account isolation
* Complete REST API

*BluWave Top Private Equity Innovator Award*: Winners were selected by a cross-functional committee
that assessed candidates in consultation with a broad universe of limited partners, investment
bankers, industry thought leaders, and service providers in the private equity ecosystem. OEP did
not provide compensation for this award.

*Mergers & Acquisitions’ Best Places to Work Award:* Winners selected after nominees were asked to
detail how they set themselves apart from their competitors in areas such as work-life balance,
training, career growth, retention and compensation/benefit packages. Nominees were also asked to
share how their organization makes an impact at the firm and/or portfolio companies including ESG,
diversity, gender equality and philanthropy initiatives. OEP did not provide compensation for this
award.

*PE Hub Deal of the Year: Mid-Cap Europe:* Winners selected after nominees were asked to detail how
they set themselves apart from their competitors in areas such as deal origination, innovation,
financing structure, operational improvements, exit strategy, and alignment with key dealmaking
trends for the year. OEP did not provide compensation for this award.

*Best Investment Website:* Winners selected after nominees were asked to detail how they set
themselves apart from their competitors in areas such as design, innovation, content, technology,
interactivity, copywriting, and ease of use. OEP did not provide compensation for this award.

OpenTextingOnline invites you to send free text messages online. That's right, you can text from
your computer to mobile phones using our app. Unlike other free SMS services we offer true
reliability and international reach! No registration, no hassles. The only thing you need is an

## How to send texts online
1. Go to opentextingonline.com.
2. Choose a destination country.
3. Enter the phone number.
4. If you wish to receive replies to your text message by email, please enter your email address.
5. Type your text message.
6. Send a text or MMS or both.
7. Wait for reply.
8. Rinse and repeat.

If you are satisfied with our text meassaging service, please spread the word

### Tips
* If you sent MMS (attached image, video, audio) and your message did not reach the destination, try
  to send plain text message instead.
* Save / load conversation feature does not work properly in "incognito" or "private" browser mode.
* For all who are testing the app, don't use words "test" or "testing" - some mobile providers can
  reject it. Text something meaningful!
* If you presented with an option to choose your recipient's mobile service provider, please select
  it. SMS delivery is going to be faster and almost guaranteed.
* If you specified return email and your text message did not reach the destination, try send it
  again without the reply option.
* In some cases it can take some time for a text message to be delivered.
* Some mobile operators may charge the recipient small fees for *receiving* text messages.

# Speak Freely

Say "hello" to a different messaging experience. An unexpected focus on privacy, combined with all
of the features you expect.


[ Get Signal ][75]

## Why use Signal?

Explore below to see why Signal is a simple, powerful, and secure messenger

## Share Without Insecurity

State-of-the-art end-to-end encryption (powered by the open source Signal Protocol) keeps your
conversations secure. We can't read your messages or listen to your calls, and no one else can
either. Privacy isn’t an optional mode — it’s just the way that Signal works. Every message, every
call, every time.

### Say Anything

Share text, voice messages, photos, videos, GIFs and files for free. Signal uses your phone's data
connection so you can avoid SMS and MMS fees.

### Speak Freely

Make crystal-clear voice and video calls to people who live across town, or across the ocean, with
no long-distance charges.

### Make Privacy Stick

Add a new layer of expression to your conversations with encrypted stickers. You can also create and
share your own sticker packs.

### Get Together with Groups

Group chats make it easy to stay connected to your family, friends, and coworkers.

## No ads. No trackers. No kidding.

There are no ads, no affiliate marketers, and no creepy tracking in Signal. So focus on sharing the
moments that matter with the people who matter to you.

## Free for Everyone

Signal is an independent nonprofit. We're not tied to any major tech companies, and we can never be
acquired by one either. Development is supported by grants and donations from people like you.

# Speak Freely

Say "hello" to a different messaging experience. An unexpected focus on privacy, combined with all
of the features you expect.


[ Get Signal ][75]

## Why use Signal?

Explore below to see why Signal is a simple, powerful, and secure messenger

## Share Without Insecurity

State-of-the-art end-to-end encryption (powered by the open source Signal Protocol) keeps your
conversations secure. We can't read your messages or listen to your calls, and no one else can
either. Privacy isn’t an optional mode — it’s just the way that Signal works. Every message, every
call, every time.

### Say Anything

Share text, voice messages, photos, videos, GIFs and files for free. Signal uses your phone's data
connection so you can avoid SMS and MMS fees.

### Speak Freely

Make crystal-clear voice and video calls to people who live across town, or across the ocean, with
no long-distance charges.

### Make Privacy Stick

Add a new layer of expression to your conversations with encrypted stickers. You can also create and
share your own sticker packs.

### Get Together with Groups

Group chats make it easy to stay connected to your family, friends, and coworkers.

## No ads. No trackers. No kidding.

There are no ads, no affiliate marketers, and no creepy tracking in Signal. So focus on sharing the
moments that matter with the people who matter to you.

## Free for Everyone

Signal is an independent nonprofit. We're not tied to any major tech companies, and we can never be
acquired by one either. Development is supported by grants and donations from people like you.

Is it legal?
Absolutely! We are an SMS activation service that helps users maintain their privacy and avoid
exposing their personal phone numbers online. We use strict filters to block any suspicious
requests, ensuring everything is completely clean and transparent.
For how long is the number issued?
25 minutes. This is more than enough time to enter the number into your app, wait for the code, and
complete the registration. If you run out of time—no big deal! You can always get a new one right
away.
Can the number be used again?
No, our numbers are for one-time use only. This is for your security: once you receive the code, the
number is removed from our system and cannot be reused by anyone else for that service. Your account
stays yours and yours alone.

VPN from the same country as the number you’re buying. If the app is acting up, simply try another
number from our huge list — it happens sometimes, and it's no problem.

arrived within 5-10 minutes, just cancel the activation. Your money will be instantly returned to
your balance, and you can try a different number or a different country.
Are refunds available?
Absolutely! We have a simple rule: no code, no pay. If you buy a number but the SMS never arrives,
the system automatically refunds the money to your balance. You only pay for actual results.
Need larger volumes — what should I do?
We are always happy to work with wholesale customers! If you need "bulk and fast," just reach out to
our support team. We can offer you special pricing, a stable supply of numbers, and tailored terms.

## What is VPN?

A VPN (Virtual Private Network) is a simple tool that keeps your online activity private and secure.
It encrypts your Internet connection, hides your IP address, and shields your personal data from
hackers, advertisers, and your internet provider. When you connect to the internet through a VPN
server, your traffic is routed through a secure tunnel making your location and identity harder to
track and helping you browse more privately, wherever you are.

# A Unified Telecom Messaging Platform Built for Wholesale & Retail Messaging Hubs

High-throughput A2P messaging powered by a modern, low-latency architecture—built for scale,
redundancy, and complete control over performance and operations.

[SMSC Core Engine]

### SMSC Core Engine

A carrier-grade SMSC engine enabling high-throughput, low-latency message processing with full
control over delivery and connectivity.

Built on a distributed, fault-tolerant architecture, it processes high-volume A2P and P2P traffic
with consistent performance and no single point of failure.

Provides protocol-level control and direct connectivity to operator networks, ensuring reliable
delivery, flexible integration, and complete operational control.

[Know More About Us][63]
[Omnichannel Messaging Layer]

### Omnichannel Messaging Layer

Unified messaging across SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Voice, and OTT channels—managed seamlessly within a
single platform.

Enables businesses to manage multi-channel communication through a centralized layer, ensuring
consistent delivery and user experience across all messaging channels.

Integrates modern communication platforms with traditional telecom networks, allowing seamless
expansion beyond SMS without operational complexity.

[Know More About Us][64]
[Control & Routing System]

### Control & Routing System

Advanced routing, filtering, and traffic management to optimize delivery, reduce costs, and maximize
performance.

Implements intelligent routing logic and rule-based traffic management to dynamically select optimal
paths based on cost, quality, and delivery performance.

Provides granular control over message flows, enabling operators and aggregators to manage traffic
efficiently while maintaining reliability and margins.

[Know More About Us][65]
[Billing & Analytics Engine]

### Billing & Analytics Engine

Real-time billing, margin control, and deep analytics to monitor performance and drive revenue
across messaging operations.

Supports flexible billing models for wholesale and retail messaging, enabling accurate charging,
margin tracking, and revenue optimization in real time.

Delivers actionable insights through detailed analytics and reporting, helping businesses monitor
performance, detect issues, and make data-driven decisions.
